title: Auburn’s Ja’Kobe Tharp breaks world record in 110 hurdles at NCAA championships
content:
Ja’Kobe Tharp of Auburn broke a world record that had stood for more than 13 years when he ran 12.75 seconds in the men’s 110-meter hurdles at the NCAA outdoor track and field championship meet Wednesday at the University of Oregon.

Tharp broke the record held by Aries Merritt, an American who ran a 12.80 in September 2012. Tharp’s record came in one of three 110 hurdles semifinals at Hayward Field in Eugene, Ore.

Entering Wednesday’s meet, the collegiate and NCAA championship record for the 110 hurdles was 12.98, set by Grant Holloway of Florida in 2019.

“Twelve seventy-five? I have more in my legs. I have no words. I’m speechless,” Tharp said on the ESPN broadcast.

Tharp, who won the 110 hurdles at last year’s NCAA championships and was runner-up in 2024, entered with a season-best time of 13.05. His time Wednesday was 0.27 seconds quicker than the second-fastest qualifier for Friday’s 110 hurdles final.

“That was not a picture-perfect race. I’m truly at a loss for words,” said Tharp, who has his sights set on the final and defending his 2025 title.

“This was all about getting through, surviving and advancing,” the junior added.

Tharp’s winning time at the 2025 NCAA meet was 13.05. He won the USATF championship last season in a lifetime best of 13.01.

According to the ESPN broadcast, Tharp is the first track and field athlete to set a world record at the NCAA championship meet since high jumper Dwight Stones cleared 7 feet, 7 inches at the 1976 NCAAs.

The four-day NCAA meet opened Wednesday as scheduled, a day after a bomb threat prompted the evacuation of Hayward Field. Athletes who were practicing at Hayward were forced to leave the stadium, but police gave the all-clear less than three hours later.

The meet continues Thursday, a day consisting largely of women’s preliminaries, followed by men’s finals Friday and women’s finals Saturday. According to Track & Field News form charts, the Arkansas men and Georgia women are headed for comfortable team victories.
